title: Nigeria Monetary Value
description: A web app that shows Nigeria's inflation and exchange rates across every era since independence, and how each era carried the country. It also includes a money time machine that tells you what your money today was worth in the past, or what money from the past is worth today.

title: Nigeria Economic Statistics
description: An in-depth web app that presents Nigeria's economic data in a clear, easy-to-read way for anyone who wants to understand the economy.

title: GlowStudio
description: A hair-care website for men and women. Customers can book hair sessions and buy hair creams (the cream range is for women only). Animations are built with GSAP.

title: OnlyCreams
description: An online cream store built on Shopify with custom theme code written in Liquid.

title: Churashawarma
description: A shawarma ordering website with a menu, ordering, and delivery options. Every order is sent straight to the owner's WhatsApp DM, so the business gets orders instantly.

title: 2026 Yearbook
description: A digital yearbook for the 2026 graduating class of Coal City University. Joining was optional, so each student chose whether to appear on the wall.
